title: Move binary zeros left and ones right
answer: Because the array contains only 0 and 1, one simple O(n) approach is to count the number of zeros in one pass, then fill the first `zeroCount` positions with 0 and the remaining positions with 1. AeroTopo's `binaryFlags` method also validates that every input is either 0 or 1 before rearranging. This uses O(1) extra space and modifies the array in place. A two-pointer partition is another valid O(n), O(1) approach if you prefer swapping rather than counting and filling.
